40022172.author: पदार्थः
40022172.content: प्रस्थाप्य having sent forth, च and, बलं the army, सर्वं all, मासमात्रोषितः having stayed for only a month, पथि on the way, एक alone, एव indeed, आशु quickly, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, जगाम went, त्वरितं swiftly, तदा then.

40022172.author: Translation
40022172.content: After sending forth his entire army and staying on the way for only a month, Shatrughna then quickly went forth alone and swiftly.

40022173.author: पदार्थः
40022173.content: द्विरात्रम् for two nights, अन्तरे during, शूरः the brave one, उष्य having stayed, राघवनन्दनः the delight of the Raghus, वाल्मीकेः of Valmiki, आश्रमं to the hermitage, पुण्यम् sacred, अगच्छत् went, वासम् dwelling, उत्तमम् excellent.

40022173.author: Translation
40022173.content: The brave Shatrughna, the delight of the Raghus, having stayed for two nights on the way, then went to the sacred and excellent hermitage of Valmiki.

40022174.author: पदार्थः
40022174.content: सः he, अभिवाद्य having saluted, महात्मानं the great-souled, वाल्मीकिं Valmiki, मुनिसत्तमम् the best of sages, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands, अथ then, भूत्वा having become, वाक्यम् words, एतत् these, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.

40022174.author: Translation
40022174.content: Having saluted the great-souled Valmiki, the best of sages, Shatrughna then stood with folded hands and spoke these words.

40022175.author: पदार्थः
40022175.content: भगवन् O venerable one, वस्तुम् to stay, इच्छामि I wish, गुरोः from the guru's, कृत्यात् task, इह here, आगतः having come. श्वः tomorrow, प्रभाते in the morning, गमिष्यामि I shall go, प्रतीचीम् western, वारुणीम् of Varuna, दिशम् direction.

40022175.author: Translation
40022175.content: Shatrughna, having arrived there for his guru's task, requested permission to stay for the night, stating his intention to depart westward the next morning.

40022176.author: पदार्थः
40022176.content: शत्रुघ्नस्य Shatrughna's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्रहस्य having smiled, मुनिपुङ्गवः the foremost among sages, प्रत्युवाच replied, महात्मानम् to the great-souled one, स्वागतम् welcome, ते to you, महायशः O greatly renowned one.

40022176.author: Translation
40022176.content: Hearing Shatrughna's words, the eminent sage Valmiki smiled and welcomed the great-souled and greatly renowned prince.

40022177.author: पदार्थः
40022177.content: स्वम् your own, आश्रमम् hermitage, इदम् this, सौम्य O gentle one, राघवाणाम् of the Raghus, कुलस्य of the family, हि indeed. आसनम् seat, पाद्यम् water for feet, अर्ध्यम् water for respectful offering, च and, निर्विशङ्कः without hesitation, प्रतीच्छ accept, मे from me.

40022177.author: Translation
40022177.content: Valmiki assured Shatrughna that this hermitage was indeed like his own, belonging to the Raghu lineage, and urged him to accept the offered seat, water for feet, and respectful offering without any hesitation.

40022178.author: पदार्थः
40022178.content: प्रतिगृह्य having accepted, तदा then, पूजां the hospitality, फलमूलम् fruits and roots, च and, भोजनम् food, भक्षयामास he ate, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha's descendant, तृप्तिम् satisfaction, च and, परमाम् supreme, गतः attained.

40022178.author: Translation
40022178.content: Shatrughna, the descendant of Kakutstha, then accepted the hospitality, ate the offered fruits and roots, and achieved supreme satisfaction.

40022179.author: पदार्थः
40022179.content: सः he, भुक्त्वा having eaten, फलमूलम् fruits and roots, च and, महर्षिम् to the great sage, तम् him, उवाच spoke, ह indeed. इयम् this, यज्ञविभूतिः splendor of sacrifice, ते your, कस्य whose, आश्रमसमीपतः near the hermitage.

40022179.author: Translation
40022179.content: After eating the fruits and roots, Shatrughna then asked the great sage about the origin of the sacrificial splendor he observed near the hermitage.

40022180.author: पदार्थः
40022180.content: तत् that, तस्य his, भाषितं spoken words, श्रुत्वा having heard, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, शत्रुघ्न O Shatrughna, शृणु listen, यस्य whose, इदं this, बभूव was, आयतनं abode, पुरा formerly,

40022180.author: Translation
40022180.content: Having heard his words, Valmiki spoke, saying, "O Shatrughna, listen to whose abode this place formerly was."

40022181.author: पदार्थः
40022181.content: युष्माकं your, पूर्वको former, राजा king, सौदासः Saudasa, तस्य his, भूपतेः of the king, पुत्रो son, वीरसहो Virasaha, नाम named, वीर्यवान् valorous, अतिधार्मिकः very righteous,

40022181.author: Translation
40022181.content: Your ancestor was King Saudasa, and his son was named Virasaha, who was mighty and exceedingly righteous.

40022182.author: पदार्थः
40022182.content: स he, बाल young, एव indeed, सौदासो Saudasa, मृगयाम् hunting, उपचक्रमे undertook, चञ्चूर्यमाणं roaming about, ददृशे saw, स he, शूरो brave, राक्षसद्वयम् two rakshasas,

40022182.author: Translation
40022182.content: When Saudasa was still young, he went hunting and that brave king saw two rakshasas roaming about.

40022183.author: पदार्थः
40022183.content: शार्दूलरूपिणौ in the form of tigers, घोरौ terrible, मृगान् animals, बहुसहस्रशः many thousands, भक्षमाणौ eating, असन्तुष्टौ unsatisfied, पर्याप्तिं satisfaction, नैव never, जग्मतुः reached,

40022183.author: Translation
40022183.content: These two terrible rakshasas, in the form of tigers, were devouring many thousands of animals but remained unsatisfied, never reaching sufficiency.

40022184.author: पदार्थः
40022184.content: स he, तु but, तौ those two, राक्षसौ rakshasas, दृष्ट्वा having seen, निर्मृगं devoid of animals, च and, वनं forest, कृतम् made, क्रोधेन by anger, महता great, आविष्टो overcome, जघानैकं killed one, महेषुणा with a great arrow,

40022184.author: Translation
40022184.content: But he, having seen those two rakshasas and the forest made devoid of animals, became overcome with great anger and killed one of them with a mighty arrow.

40022185.author: पदार्थः
40022185.content: विनिपात्य having struck down, तम् him, एकम् one, तु indeed, सौदासः Saudasa, पुरुषर्षभः best among men, विज्वरः free from distress, विगतामार्षः free from anger, हतम् killed, रक्षः the demon, हि indeed, उदैक्षत he saw.

40022185.author: Translation
40022185.content: King Saudasa, the best among men, having struck down that one demon, looked at the killed demon, now free from distress and anger.

40022186.author: पदार्थः
40022186.content: निरीक्षमाणम् looking on, तम् him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सहायम् the companion, तस्य of that, रक्षसः demon, सन्तापम् sorrow, अकरोत् he made, घोरम् terrible, सौदासम् to Saudasa, च and, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् he said.

40022186.author: Translation
40022186.content: Having seen Saudasa looking on, the companion of that demon felt terrible sorrow and spoke these words to Saudasa.

40022187.author: पदार्थः
40022187.content: यस्मात् because, अनपराधम् innocent, त्वम् you, सहायम् companion, मम my, जघ्निवान् have killed, तस्मात् therefore, तव to you, अपि also, पापिष्ठ O most sinful one, प्रदास्यामि I will give, प्रतिक्रियाम् retaliation.

40022187.author: Translation
40022187.content: The demon declared, "Because you have killed my innocent companion, O most sinful one, I will therefore give you retaliation."

40022188.author: पदार्थः
40022188.content: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, तु indeed, तत् that, राक्षसः demon, तत्रैव right there, अन्तरधीयत disappeared, कालपर्याययोगेन by the passage of time, राजा the king, मित्रसहः Mitrasaha, अभवत् became.

40022188.author: Translation
40022188.content: Having spoken thus, that demon indeed disappeared right there, and in due course, the king became known as Mitrasaha.

40022189.author: पदार्थः
40022189.content: राजा the king, अपि also, यजते performs, यज्ञम् a sacrifice, अस्य of this, आश्रमसमीपतः near the hermitage, अश्वमेधम् Ashwamedha, महायज्ञम् great sacrifice, तम् that, वसिष्ठः Vasishtha, अभ्यपालयत् supervised.

40022189.author: Translation
40022189.content: The king also performs a great Ashwamedha sacrifice near this hermitage, and Vasishtha supervised that sacrifice.

40022190.author: पदार्थः
40022190.content: तत्र there, यज्ञो a sacrifice, महान् great, आसीत् was, बहुवर्षगणायुतः lasting for many years, समृद्धः prosperous, परया with supreme, लक्ष्म्या splendor, देवयज्ञसमः equal to a sacrifice of the gods, अभवत् it became.

40022190.author: Translation
40022190.content: There was a great sacrifice that lasted for many years, which became exceedingly prosperous and splendid, rivaling even the sacrifices performed by the gods.

40022191.author: पदार्थः
40022191.content: अथ then, अवसाने at the conclusion, यज्ञस्य of the sacrifice, पूर्ववैरम् the old enmity, अनुस्मरन् remembering, वसिष्ठरूपी in the form of Vasiṣṭha, राजानम् to the king, इति thus, होवाच spoke, राक्षसः the demon.

40022191.author: Translation
40022191.content: Then, at the conclusion of the sacrifice, the demon, remembering his old enmity and disguised as Vasiṣṭha, spoke thus to the king.

40022192.author: पदार्थः
40022192.content: अस्य of this, यज्ञस्य sacrifice, जातः has come, अन्तः the end, सामिषम् with meat, भोजनम् food, मम for me, दीयताम् let it be given, इह here, शीघ्रम् quickly, वै indeed, न not, अत्र here, कार्या should be done, विचारणा deliberation.

40022192.author: Translation
40022192.content: The demon, disguised as Vasiṣṭha, demanded that since the sacrifice had concluded, meat-laden food should be given to him quickly without any further deliberation.

40022193.author: पदार्थः
40022193.content: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, व्याहृतम् spoken, वाक्यम् word, रक्षसा by the demon, ब्रह्मरूपिणा in the form of a Brahmin, भक्ष्यसंस्कारकुशलम् to one skilled in preparing food, उवाच spoke, पृथिवीपतिः the king.

40022193.author: Translation
40022193.content: Having heard that speech spoken by the demon disguised as a Brahmin, the king then addressed the person skilled in preparing food.

40022194.author: पदार्थः
40022194.content: हविष्यम् sacrificial food, सामिषम् with meat, स्वादु delicious, यथा so that, भवति it becomes, भोजनम् food, तथा thus, कुरुष्व do, शीघ्रम् quickly, वै indeed, परितुष्येत् may be pleased, यथा so that, गुरुः the preceptor.

40022194.author: Translation
40022194.content: The king instructed the cook to quickly prepare the sacrificial food with meat, making it delicious, so that the preceptor (Vasiṣṭha) would be pleased.

40022195.author: पदार्थः
40022195.content: शासनात् from the command, पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य of the king of kings, सूदः the cook, सम्भ्रान्तमानसः with a bewildered mind, सः that, राक्षसः demon, पुनः again, तत्र there, सूदवेषम् the guise of a cook, अथ then, अकरोत् assumed.

40022195.author: Translation
40022195.content: Due to the king's command, the cook was bewildered, and that demon again assumed the guise of a cook there.

40022196.author: पदार्थः
40022196.content: सः he, मानुषम् human, अथ then, मांसम् flesh, पार्थिवाय to the king, न्यवेदयत् presented, इदम् this, स्वादु delicious, हविष्यम् fit for oblation, च and, सामिषम् with meat, च and, अन्नम् food, आहृतम् brought.

40022196.author: Translation
40022196.content: He then presented human flesh to the king, saying, "This delicious food, fit for oblation and mixed with meat, has been brought."

40022197.author: पदार्थः
40022197.content: सः he, भोजनम् the meal, वसिष्ठाय to Vasistha, पत्न्या with his wife, सार्धम् together, उपाहरत् offered, मदयन्त्या with Madayanti, नरव्याघ्र O tiger among men, सामिषम् with meat, रक्षसा by the demon, हृतम् prepared.

40022197.author: Translation
40022197.content: O tiger among men, he (the king) offered that meal, which was prepared with meat by the demon, to Vasistha along with his wife Madayanti.

40022198.author: पदार्थः
40022198.content: ज्ञात्वा having known, तत् that, आमिषम् meat, विप्रः the brahmin, मानुषम् human, भाजनम् into the vessel, गतम् gone, क्रोधेन by anger, महता great, आविष्टः overcome, व्याहर्तुम् to speak, उपचक्रमे began.

40022198.author: Translation
40022198.content: Realizing that the meat in the vessel was human flesh, the brahmin (Vasistha), overcome by great anger, began to speak (a curse).

40022199.author: पदार्थः
40022199.content: यस्मात् because, त्वम् you, भोजनम् food, राजन् O king, मम to me, एतत् this, दातुम् to give, इच्छसि desire, तस्मात् therefore, भोजनम् food, एतत् this, ते your, भविष्यति will be, न no, संशयः doubt.

40022199.author: Translation
40022199.content: "Because you desire to give me this food, O king, therefore this very food shall be yours, without a doubt," (Vasistha cursed).

40022200.author: पदार्थः
40022200.content: ततः then, क्रुद्धस्तु enraged, सौदासः Saudasa, तोयम् water, जग्राह took, पाणिना with his hand, वसिष्ठम् Vasistha, शप्तुम् to curse, आरेभे began, भार्या his wife, च and, एनम् him, अवारयत् restrained.

40022200.author: Translation
40022200.content: Then, enraged, King Saudasa took water in his hand and began to curse Vasistha, but his wife restrained him.

40022201.author: पदार्थः
40022201.content: राजन् O King, प्रभुः master, यतः because, अस्माकम् our, वसिष्ठः Vasistha, भगवान् revered, ऋषिः sage, प्रतिशप्तुम् to curse back, न not, शक्तः capable, त्वम् you, देवतुल्यम् god-like, पुरोधसम् priest.

40022201.author: Translation
40022201.content: She said, "O King, because the revered sage Vasistha is our master, you are not capable of cursing back this god-like priest."

40022202.author: पदार्थः
40022202.content: ततः then, क्रोधमयम् imbued with anger, तोयम् water, तेजोबलसमन्वितम् endowed with power and strength, व्यसर्जयत released, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, ततः then, पादौ feet, सिषेच sprinkled, च and.

40022202.author: Translation
40022202.content: Then, the righteous king, releasing the water imbued with anger, power, and strength, poured it onto his own feet.

40022203.author: पदार्थः
40022203.content: तेन by that, अस्य his, राज्ञः of the king, तौ those, पादौ feet, तदा then, कल्माषताम् spottedness, गतौ attained, तदाप्रभृति from then onwards, राजा king, असौ that, सौदासः Saudasa, सुमहायशाः greatly renowned, कल्माषपादः Kalmashapada, संवृत्तः became, ख्यातः famous, चैव and indeed, तथा thus, नृपः king.

40022203.author: Translation
40022203.content: By that water, the king's feet then became spotted, and from that time onwards, the greatly renowned King Saudasa became known as Kalmashapada, the spotted-footed king.

40022204.author: पदार्थः
40022204.content: सः that, राजा king, सह with, पत्न्या his wife, वै indeed, प्रणिपत्य having bowed down, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, पुनः again, वसिष्ठम् to Vasistha, प्रोवाच spoke, यत् what, उक्तम् was said, ब्रह्मरूपिणा by the one in the form of Brahma.

40022204.author: Translation
40022204.content: That king, along with his wife, having bowed down repeatedly, then spoke again to Vasistha, who was like Brahma in his wisdom.

40022205.author: पदार्थः
40022205.content: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य of the king of kings, रक्षसा by the Rakshasa, विकृतं transformed, च and, तत् that, पुनः again, प्रोवाच spoke, राजानं to the king, वसिष्ठः Vasistha, पुरुषर्षभम् to the best among men.

40022205.author: Translation
40022205.content: Having heard that the king of kings was transformed by the Rakshasa, Vasistha again spoke to the king, who was the best among men.

40022206.author: पदार्थः
40022206.content: मया by me, रोषपरीतेन overcome by anger, यत् which, इदं this, व्याहृतं spoken, वचः word, न not, एतत् this, शक्यं possible, वृथा in vain, कर्तुं to make, प्रदास्यामि I will give, च and, ते to you, वरम् a boon.

40022206.author: Translation
40022206.content: The words I have spoken while overcome by anger cannot be made in vain, but I will grant you a boon.

40022207.author: पदार्थः
40022207.content: कालः the time, द्वादश twelve, वर्षाणि years, शापस्य of the curse, अन्तः the end, भविष्यति will be, मत्प्रासादात् by my grace, च and, राजेन्द्र O king of kings, व्यतीतं what has passed, न not, स्मरिष्यसि you will remember.

40022207.author: Translation
40022207.content: The duration of the curse will be twelve years, and by my grace, O king of kings, you will not remember what has transpired.

40022208.author: पदार्थः
40022208.content: एवं thus, सः that, राजा king, तं that, शापं curse, उपभुज्य having experienced, अरिसूदनः destroyer of enemies, प्रतिलेभे regained, पुनः again, राज्यं kingdom, प्रजाः subjects, च and, एव indeed, अन्वपालयत् protected.

40022208.author: Translation
40022208.content: Thus, that king, the destroyer of enemies, having endured the curse, regained his kingdom and indeed protected his subjects.

40022209.author: पदार्थः
40022209.content: तस्य of him, कल्माषपादस्य of Kalmashapada, यज्ञस्य of the sacrifice, आयतनं the place, शुभम् auspicious, आश्रमस्य of the hermitage, समीपे near, अस्य of this, यत् which, मां me, पृच्छसि you ask, राघव O Raghava.

40022209.author: Translation
40022209.content: O Raghava, the auspicious place of sacrifice belonging to Kalmashapada, which you ask me about, is near this hermitage.

40022210.author: पदार्थः
40022210.content: तस्य his, ताम् that, पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य of the king, कथाम् story, श्रुत्वा having heard, सुदारुणाम् very terrible, विवेश entered, पर्णशालायाम् into the hermitage, महर्षिम् the great sage, अभिवाद्य having saluted, च and.

40022210.author: Translation
40022210.content: Having heard that very terrible story of the king, he saluted the great sage and entered the hermitage. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे पञ्चषष्टितमः सर्गः ।। 65 ।। Thus ends the sixty-fifth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
